Name: Shadow over Elliot
Author: piefrie
Description:
Hello! This mod just requires Content Patcher and of course SMAPI. It overwrites Elliot to be Shadow (so he is an optional romance if you so desire). 
This replaces all his dialogue with Shadow's name instead of Elliot's, his portraits for every outfit, and his sprites for every outfit. If you run into any issues, please comment <3.

Manifest.Name: Shadow
Manifest.Description: Replaces the sprites, portraits, and names of Elliot with Shadow the Hedgehog.
Manifest.Author: piefry
